name: Marching Cubes with Lewiner 2003 Ambiguity Resolution
aliases: Marching Cubes with Face and Internal Ambiguities
Marching Cubes with Lewiner/Nielson-Hamann Ambiguity Resolution
definition: A volumetric surface extraction method that resolves topological ambiguities in the standard Marching Cubes algorithm by testing faces and interior points of the cube, based on the Lewiner 2003 paper.
summary: Marching Cubes with Lewiner 2003 Ambiguity Resolution is a volumetric surface extraction method that guarantees manifold surfaces by resolving topological ambiguities through face and interior point tests.
